]> 19/08/2026 7:30 The early bird catches the worm! .

Good morning and happy Wednesday. This morning at Perisher the skies are clear, but the weather is set to turn later today. Enjoy the morning on some fast groomers before the weather comes in around lunch time.

It's currently 4 degrees and we're headed for a top of 8 degrees. The winds are north-westerly around 20-30km/h, increasing throughout the day up to 60km/h.

There are 59 groomed runs and 37 lifts set to spin across the resort. It will be firm and fast first up but will soften quickly with the warm temperatures.

State Interschools continues today, with racing taking place on Front Valley, Centre Valley and Mogul Matts. Best of luck to all of the competitors.

We also have some great retail sales kicking off in Slopestyle and Perisher Sports, with up to 50% off select products. If you're in need of a gear refresh, now's a great time to buy!

Have a great day out there. The early bird catches the worm today!
